description.value: Jade Fountain Restaurant is a dim sum and Chinese cuisine destination located inside the Red Lion Inn & Suites on Douglas Street in Victoria. The kitchen focuses on handcrafted traditional dishes — dumplings, savory buns, spring rolls, and pastries — made with fresh ingredients. Online ordering and DoorDash delivery are available alongside dine-in service, making it a flexible stop for a hot meal.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (13 spaces) at 7m; rack (4 spaces) at 35m. Total: 17 spaces.
